2. **"we buy from gardens we've visited"**: an unsupported sourcing claim. Either supply proof (which gardens, who visited, when) or cut it. If you can confirm it, add it to the allowlist and I'll keep it. For now: `[PROOF NEEDED: which gardens you buy from and that the team has visited them]`.

**Suggested compliant version**

> Pebblebrook was founded in Bristol in 2019. We're a small team of six, and every tin is packed by hand in Bristol. Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. [PROOF NEEDED: gardens you buy from and have visited]
